text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...!!
Wheeze... haa...!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"I-I'm okay... I'm fine.
I mean... I wasn't good enough yet, after all!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't catch up to Miss Bourbon!
...That's why, I have to try even harder...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I have... to hang... in there...!
(Thud...)

It seems she gave it everything she had,
and the tension finally snapped.

"...I'll lend her my shoulder for a bit
and let her rest. Thinking that, as I began to walk—"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: —Her remarks are incomprehensible.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Given how this race played out,
she should have said, 'I lost to Bourbon.'

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It is not a matter of "catching up" or "not catching up."
Shouldn't you correct that misconception?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Incomprehensible.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry!
Rice caused trouble again...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...*Sigh*. Rice is just
no good at all, huh...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I caused so much trouble...
And in the race... I couldn't catch up, either.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...At the very least, I have to do my best next time.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hey... Big Brother.
The races Bourbon-san will definitely be aiming for are—
choice_data_list: It'll be the Kikuka Sho, I reckon.
It'll probably be the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hey... Big Sister.
The races Bourbon-san will definitely be aiming for are—
choice_data_list: It'll be the Kikuka Sho, I reckon.
It'll probably be the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You're right.
...So Rice needs to... Okay.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best.
Next time... I'll definitely catch up to you.

"The final race of the Triple Crown route,
the 'Kikuka Sho,' is a long-distance turf race of 3,000 meters."

For a stayer like Rice Shower,
this is sure to be the most crucial race yet—!
